head: codex/5863-node-identity-enrollment
title: [v0.92][WP-04.01] Add authenticated distributed node enrollment
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5863

## Summary
- add stable node and Guardian identities with Ed25519-authenticated enrollment
- enforce one effective Guardian control key per quorum voter
- fail closed on replay, malformed or oversized requests, durable-state corruption, audit gaps, and symlinked storage paths
- retain exact nonzero validation and independent review evidence

## Validation
- `cargo nextest run --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_identity --no-tests=fail` (13 passed, 0 skipped)
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_identity -- -D warnings`
- WP-04.01 exact revision proof receipt
